correctness.rationale: Exhaustive structural classification of high-side incidence configurations yields exact Z_n, single- and two-edge containing counts for all three orbits. Polynomial factorization gives strictly positive Rayleigh gaps at all integer n>=3. An independently implemented union-find enumerator and rational/coefficientwise algebra checker passed 4,825 assertions; finite experiments are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: General uniform-forest pairwise edge negative correlation is a motivated open question. The proposed claim resolves all three edge-pair orbits for an infinite 3-connected non-series-parallel family, including the previously troublesome vertex-disjoint case, and gives two distinct quantitative decay regimes. This adds meaningful structural information beyond known forest counts.
